encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἵνα Καλλιμέδοντ’ εἰς τοὔψον, εἰ φιλεῖς ἐμέ,
Β. ἔργον τυράννων, οὐκ ἀγορανόμων λέγεις.
μάχιμος γὰρ ἁνήρ, χρήσιμος δὲ τῇ πόλει.

div.note: Athenaeus 8, 340 b εἰς δὲ ὀψοφαγίαν (Καλλιμέδοντα σκώπτει Ἄλεξις) ἐν Φαίδωνι ἢ Φαιδρίᾳ οὕτως κτλ.

1. θέλωσι, σύ, ἵνα] θέλωσιν συϊνα Α. 5. ἁνὴρ Dindf.] ἀνήρ Α. — cf. fr. 67. 1. de agoranomis cf. Arist. Ach. 723. 824. Schoemann. Ant. gr.² I 431. 2. cf. Arist. Nub. 82. 3. δι’ ὅλης ἡμέρας, ut Arist. Pac. 27 δι’ ἡμέρας ὅλης. sed cum versari in foro per totum diem possit, inruere in forum non possit, scribendum videtur δὶς τῆς ἡμέρας. cf. Plat. com. 207. Polioch. 2, 3. scilicet δὶς τῆς ἡμέρας δειπνεῖν luxuriosi erat hominis. 5. δόκιμος γὰρ ἁνὴρ χρήσιμός τε τῇ πόλει?
